basic_details.job_title: IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ABV-Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management Gwalior (IIITM Gwalior) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on a temporary basis under advertisement number ACPL/2026/2/R1. The engagement is initially for one year and may be extended further till the completion of the project based on satisfactory performance. The pay for the post is Rs. 25,000 per month (Consolidated), and candidates must hold an M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or Electronics. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the essential educational qualifications and age criteria specified for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Applicants must have an M.Sc./M.Tech. qualification recognized by the institute with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale in a qualifying degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or Electronics. M.Sc. candidates should have a valid NET (JRF)/GATE score. Candidates having a strong background in Solid-State Physics or Electronics will be preferred. Candidates should have experience in ab-initio calculations. Applicants should preferably be below 28 years of age as on 2nd Nov. 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare the signed application along with all educational qualifications combined into a single PDF file. Send the application via email to the official email address: [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the designated email on or before 2nd Nov. 2026 till 05:00 PM. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. The interview will be conducted in offline or online mode. In case a large number of applications are received, the committee may apply higher criteria for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send the signed application via email is 2nd Nov. 2026 till 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly stipend provided for this JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech. degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or Electronics with at least 60% marks or a 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale. M.Sc. degree holders must also have a valid NET (JRF) or GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required to apply for this post.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the interview date and mode (offline or online).
